question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
-- For each unique start year, count movies in the 10-year period [start, start+9], return only the top one
WITH movie_years AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(regexp_replace(year, '^[IVXLCDM]+ ', '') AS INTEGER) as num_year
    FROM Movie
),
unique_starts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT num_year as start_year
    FROM movie_years
)
SELECT 
    us.start_year,
    COUNT(my.num_year) as film_count
FROM unique_starts us
LEFT JOIN movie_years my ON my.num_year >= us.start_year AND my.num_year < us.start_year + 10
GROUP BY us.start_year
ORDER BY film_count DESC, us.start_year ASC
LIMIT 1
